deadline.value: January 9 for September admission (early applications encouraged). Year inferred for September 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: January 9 (for admission in September, early applications encouraged)

gre_subject.value: Encouraged (not required) for applicants schooled outside Canada
gre_subject.quote: Students who did not complete their schooling in Canada are encouraged to submit a Physics subject GRE score, however it is not required for a successful application.

supervisor.value: Admission requires a faculty member willing to supervise you; contact before or after applying and name supervisors on the application
supervisor.quote: admission into a graduate program requires matching with a faculty member that is willing to serve as your supervisor.

funding.value: Funding package for all graduate students within program time limits (GRS, TA, awards); TA two of three terms
funding.quote: The Department of Physics & Astronomy provides a nationally competitive funding package to all of our graduate students within their program time limits.

entry_route.value: PhD normally requires a master's in physics (75%+); MSc students can transfer to an accelerated PhD
entry_route.quote: Normally a Master's degree in Physics, with at least a 75% standing.

app_fee.quote: pay the non-refundable application fee of $150 CAD per program via the link in your portal.

english_waiver.value: Exempt only if 3+ years of study at a university listed in WHED with English as the ONLY language of instruction; exemption expires 2 years after graduation; medium-of-instruction letters are not accepted
english_waiver.quote: You have completed three or more years of post-secondary education, or completed a graduate degree at a university where English is listed as the only language of instruction on the International Association of Universities World Higher Education Database (WHED). | Letters from your university stating the medium of instruction is English do not satisfy Waterloo admission requirements.

notes: Physics PhD streams include Nanotechnology and Quantum Information (IQC, Perimeter affiliations).
